blocks.text: A thin figure lowers a lamp. “You are the new keeper,” it says, as if it had been told.
It does not say who told it.
The great lamp stands ready, and so do you.
You strike the match.

blocks.text: Gold light pours down the stair and out to sea. Every ship you cannot see turns toward it.
You are the keeper now.
The archive closes behind you, quietly, as if it had never been open.
